data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Irish name Niall, meaning 'cloud' or 'champion'. This name was borne by several important figures in Irish history, including Niall of the Nine Hostages and Niall of the Silken Tongue. The name Neall carries the meaning “Brave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Neall usually hope their child will grow to embody brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing bravery and strength in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Neall belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neall total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
data.cultural_impact: The name Neall has rich cultural significance in Irish history. The most famous bearer of the name is Niall of the Nine Hostages, who ruled Ireland from 376 to 405 AD. He was known for his military prowess and diplomatic skills, which contributed to the growth of his kingdom. He is also remembered for his hospitality, which was extended to the legendary high-king of Ireland, Conall Cernach, and his warriors. Stories about Niall have been passed down through generations, preserving the rich cultural heritage of ancient Ireland.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Neall is derived from the Old Irish word "niall," which translates to 'cloud'. This name may have been given to infants born during cloudy or stormy weather. In a spiritual sense, the name Neall could symbolize the protection that a cloud offers from the harsh rays of the sun, or the transformation and renewal that follows a storm. In biblical reference, the cloud has been used as a symbol of God's presence, to guide and protect His people (Exodus 13:21-22). Thus, the name Neall carries a spiritual significance of divine protection and guidance, reminding us of God's presence in our lives.
